name: Almacelles (Spain)
description: Dark green field with a white horizontal stripe below the centre, charged towards the hoist with a purple five-pointed spike (pentadàctil).
history: The official flag of Almacelles is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark green, with a white fess of width 7/38 of the height of the cloth set at 6/19 from the lower edge, and a purple pentadactyl of height 15/19 of the cloth; published in the DOGC on 17 June 2005.

features.role: horizontal stripe of 7/38 of the height set at 6/19 from the lower edge
